paper.basisText: Win = positive gross result at close. Currencies are kept separate. Net deducts modelled costs (assumption: fixed fee + spread, stored per trade) and adds declared dividends (unofficial source; uncertain events excluded; another currency is never converted). Splits: open positions are adjusted with a source; a closed one with a split is not rewritten and is excluded from the hit rate. No short financing, FX, cash ledger or capital. An early exit does not validate a 5-year thesis. Simulated quantity: assumption.

page.title: ProPicks AI
page.metaDescription: Current selection from the AI funnel over the liquid universe, with each card's data date and a separate walk-forward backtest.
page.methodFunnel: The v1 funnel scores each category when there is data to compute it (profitability, growth, cash and financial health are derived from stored filings) and publishes here the latest run's selection, with its data date on each card. In current picks without data, valuation and momentum enter as neutral (50) and are marked n/a on the cards: valuation needs CFROI and WACC per company and momentum needs price series, and that data doesn't yet cover the whole universe.
page.methodBacktest: The backtest in the «Backtesting» tab is a separate walk-forward baseline (12-1M momentum over 30 stocks, 15 bp costs, SPY as benchmark): it validates the point-in-time engine, not the AI strategy.

walkForward.title: Point-in-time walk-forward backtest
walkForward.emptyDescription: Each monthly cutoff needs at least 253 prior closes for every symbol in the universe plus the following month's exit close; if the price provider doesn't return those series, the engine drops the cutoff and there are no months left to measure. No zeros are shown: a 0.00% with no months behind it isn't a result.
walkForward.summary: {months} months simulated, {picks} picks per month, monthly selection using only data available before each cutoff.
walkForward.scopeWarning: This measures a momentum strategy on 30 current mega-caps. It doesn't measure ProPicks' quality and value selection.
walkForward.netReturnNote: Compounded, after costs (15 bp per leg)
walkForward.monthlyCaption: Monthly performance of the walk-forward backtest: cutoff, picks, net return, SPY and turnover

method.pointInTime: Monthly walk-forward: each cutoff uses only closing prices from before that cutoff (no look-ahead data).
method.signal: Signal: 12-1M momentum (skipping the most recent month) on a liquid universe of 30 stocks; {picks} equal-weighted picks.
method.costs: Costs applied: 15 bp per leg of turnover. Average monthly turnover: {turnover}.
method.benchmark: Benchmark: SPY buy & hold over the same period.
method.survivorship: Survivorship bias: the 30 companies are today's mega-caps, chosen with current knowledge; those that fell or left the index aren't included.
method.shortSample: Short sample: {months} months. Sharpe, Sortino and the gap versus SPY can't be told apart from chance with so little data.
method.prices: Provider closing prices without explicit dividends; no taxes or slippage beyond the stated costs.
method.snapshots: The ProPicks selection (quality, value, insiders, 13F) is frozen each month in a point-in-time snapshot; that history is the basis for a future backtest without look-ahead bias, and there aren't enough months yet.
method.disclaimer: Simulated past results don't guarantee future returns. This is not financial advice.

factsheet.weightsNote: Minimum entry score: {score}/100. The weights are the strategy's actual rule (this is how the funnel computes its strategy score). A category with no data in the run comes in neutral (50) and adds nothing to the ranking: on the cards in the “AI selection” tab it shows as
factsheet.whyNoFiguresTitle: Why there are no figures here
factsheet.whyNoFiguresBefore: A per-strategy backtest needs the fundamentals
factsheet.whyNoFiguresAfter: so it doesn't look into the future. The funnel keeps a single run (the latest), and in it valuation needs per-company CFROI and WACC, data that doesn't cover the whole universe today: without that dated series there's nothing to measure, and without measurements there are no figures to publish. It isn't replaced with an estimate.
factsheet.onlyBacktestBefore: The product's only measured backtest is the global baseline in the
factsheet.onlyBacktestAfter: tab (12-1M momentum on 30 stocks, 15 bp per leg, SPY as the benchmark). It's independent of this strategy: it measures the point-in-time engine, not its rulebook.
factsheet.footer: These are figures from the global walk-forward baseline (12-1M momentum), not from this strategy's rule: “No data” on a metric means the backtest doesn't provide it, and it's left out rather than estimated.
